index.html.description: Explore Creative Acquisitions, preview the book’s deal topics and use buyer diligence resources. Ask about current book availability and formats.
index.html.heading: Preview the acquisition approach before choosing the book
index.html.body:
Review the book overview, chapter topics and the acquisition due-diligence checklist. Use them to identify questions about structure, financing and responsibilities that need professional review for your own transaction.

Ask about book availability and formats before ordering elsewhere. Examples and deal structures are educational, not a commitment that a seller or lender will accept particular terms.
